lineCountMethod: Physical Markdown lines counted with splitlines(); cumulative state updated incrementally. Revisions use previous cumulative - old README lines + revised README lines.
chronologicalOrderBasis: Repository creation date (startDate) is the canonical historical sort key. Repository index is a persistent processing identifier; chronology backfills may therefore have an earlier startDate than lower processing indices.
latestUpdatePolicy: Latest meaningful repository commit/activity supported by repository history; metadata-only updated_at changes are not used as implementation updates.
corpusScope: 138 connected source repositories currently accessible from the GitHub portfolio, including public and private repositories. The portfolio-rag repository itself is excluded because it is the generated corpus destination rather than a source project.
